root_cause: PR #36921 fixes an out-of-bounds read in the GPU convolution f16 1x1 kernel (convolution_gpu_bfyx_f16_1x1.cl). However, the CPU functional test smoke_Conv1x1WeightCompressedToMatmul fails with catastrophic numerical errors (all 128/128 elements wrong, diff of ~2320 vs threshold 0.05). This is the same CPU test that failed on run 31174378977 for a different PR (PR #37141). This suggests the CPU plugin's Conv1x1WeightCompressedToMatmul transformation has a pre-existing instability or is sensitive to an earlier merged change, causing it to yield corrupted output (f32+i4 weight-compressed matmul path). The PR under review only touches the GPU CL kernel file and is unlikely to be the direct cause of this CPU failure.
recommended_actions: Investigate the same Conv1x1WeightCompressedToMatmul test that failed in run 31174378977 (PR #37141). Both PRs hit the exact same failing test configuration - this may be a pre-existing regression on master caused by an earlier merged change.
Run the smoke_Conv1x1WeightCompressedToMatmul test suite on the clean master branch (without this PR) to determine if the test is already broken.
If the test is broken on master, file a CPU plugin bug tracking issue and temporarily disable the test until fixed.
Review PR #37141 (RoPEFusionLtxVideo changes) as a likely source of the regression since it was identified as the suspected cause in the prior investigation.
prevention_strategies: CPU transformation changes that add new subgraph fusion patterns should run the full Conv1x1WeightCompressedToMatmul and FullyConnected weight-compression test suites before merge. Flaky or serially-failing tests should be gated with required status checks.
historical_context: Identical test failure occurred in run 31174378977 (PR #37141, 35 minutes earlier). That investigation attributed the failure to a new RoPEFusionLtxVideo transformation interfering with the Conv1x1-to-matmul path. The current PR (#36921) only touches the GPU kernel file, suggesting this CPU test is broken on master independently of this PR.
